title: EU has no idea who will pay for €90 bn Ukraine loan – MEP
description: The EU still has no idea how the burden of the €90 bn Ukraine loan will be distributed among member states, MEP Fabio De Masi said Read Full Article at RT.com

analysis.summary: EU's announcement regarding the distribution of the Ukraine loan highlights a key aspect of global macroeconomics, requiring immediate attention for its implications on European and international economies.
